question: What is the meaning of maintenance log in relation to use and operate phase?
description: During the use phase, information on materials and components can aid the facility management (e.g. maintenance) or alteration process (e.g. transformation). Maintenance log is a record of maintenance activities, including the date, time, location, description of work, and any relevant notes. It helps in tracking the condition of the building and its components, ensuring timely repairs, and optimizing maintenance schedules. This information is crucial for effective facility management and can also support future alterations or transformations.
